mapper.select: SELECT rsa_id, rsa_resume_id, rsa_file_name, rsa_file_size, rsa_content_type, rsa_created_at, rsa_file_path FROM t_res_attachment WHERE rsa_resume_id = #{resumeId} AND rsa_user_id = #{userId} AND rsa_status = 1 ORDER BY rsa_created_at DESC, rsa_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_res_attachment ( rsa_resume_id, rsa_user_id, rsa_file_path, rsa_file_name, rsa_file_size, rsa_content_type, rsa_status ) SELECT #{resumeId}, rbs_user_id, #{filePath}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, 1 FROM t_res_base WHERE rbs_id = #{resumeId} AND rbs_status = 1
